_doc: PRE-REGISTERED spec for the trendline BREAK entry battery (S1 of the 2026-07-14 trendline review). FROZEN BEFORE any replay is run -- exploratory != confirmatory, no re-picks after seeing results, a FAIL/KILL is a publishable outcome. Checked first: the in-flight audit crew's own frozen spec (analysis/recommendations/trendline-structure-conviction-preregistration.json) tests a DIFFERENT mechanism (a conviction OVERRIDE that rescues signals block_elite_bull would otherwise block) -- it is not an entry-on-break battery and does not cover V1/V2/V3 below, so it has NOT landed for this study; this file is the (not-otherwise-existing) break-entry pre-registration the task called for. The audit's own spec stays untouched (FROZEN_PENDING_RUN, owned by that crew, explicitly deferred by its own text -- not run here).
signal_source: analysis/trendlines/break-dataset.jsonl (G1, 380-day walk-forward, 78191 qualifying lines / 52833 breaks, 9/9 guard tests pass, committed). Dataset date_range ends 2026-07-13 -- TODAY (2026-07-14, the hypothesis-source day) is EXCLUDED FROM ALL EVALUATION WINDOWS BY CONSTRUCTION (the dataset simply does not contain it), not by a post-hoc filter.
families_never_blended: Every cell is reported separately per anchor_family (wick vs body) AND per kind/direction (support/bearish vs resistance/bullish) -- never pooled. 2x2 = 4 populations x 3 variants = 12 candidate cells.

V1_close_through_immediate.population_filter: break.break_type == 'close_through' (the wider wick_through_only breaks are excluded from V1/V3 -- a wick poke that closes back inside is a fakeout, not a confirmed break; V2 below is where retest+rejection recovers signal from the noisier wick_through_only population if any exists)
V1_close_through_immediate.entry_rule: Enter at the OPEN of the bar immediately AFTER the break bar (break_unix + 300s). The break is only known at the break bar's CLOSE (C6: decision uses only bars <= break bar), so the earliest actionable fill is the next bar's open -- matches production 1-min-actuator-after-closed-5m-bar convention.
V1_close_through_immediate.side: PUT for bearish (kind=support) breaks, CALL for bullish (kind=resistance) breaks
V1_close_through_immediate.strike: ATM = round(entry_spot) -- V15_SAFE_TIERS' own 0-10K equity band is ATM (offset 0), matching CLAUDE.md live truth for core Safe

V2_break_retest_entry.population_filter: break.break_type == 'close_through', AND a genuine retest+rejection is found by WALKING FORWARD from break_bar_idx+1 through break_bar_idx+10 (matches RETEST_WINDOWS_BARS[0]=10 from trendline_break_replay.py) using the IDENTICAL line-value/tolerance math imported from that module (tbr._line_value, tbr.TOL) -- NOT the dataset's own retest_within_10bar boolean, because that boolean is itself computed by looking at bars AFTER the break and would be a look-ahead FILTER if used to gate entries (C6 violation: you cannot know at decision time whether a retest will occur in the next 10 bars). A bar TOUCHES if its wick/body extreme (same accessor as the line's anchors) comes within the dynamic tolerance of the line's projected value; the rejection close may confirm on the touch bar itself or either of the next 2 bars (REJECT_CONFIRM_LOOKFORWARD_BARS=2, still inside the 10-bar horizon and still fully causal -- entry fires only after the confirming bar closes). Same-bar-only confirmation was tried first and produced 0/6000 hits in a pre-run code-correctness smoke test (touch tolerance ~$0.9-1.1 on SPY is wider than one 5m candle's typical range, so same-candle touch+reject essentially never happens) -- widening the confirmation window to 2 bars is a pre-run implementation fix (no cell pnl/verdict had been computed yet), not a post-hoc re-pick on results. If no bar in the 10-bar window ever touches-then-confirms, no trade fires for that line under V2 -- this variant necessarily has fewer, later-entered trades than V1.
V2_break_retest_entry.entry_rule: Enter at the OPEN of the bar immediately after the retest-confirmation bar's close (same next-bar-open convention as V1, just anchored to the later retest bar instead of the break bar).
V2_break_retest_entry.strike: ATM = round(entry_spot) at the retest bar

V3_break_volume_expansion.population_filter: break.break_type == 'close_through' AND break.volume_ratio >= 1.5 (threshold fixed a priori: break-dataset-summary.json's own mean_volume_ratio_at_break across all 4 family/direction cells is 1.58-1.85 -- 1.5 is the natural 'above-average conviction' cutoff, picked BEFORE running, never tuned against results). volume_ratio is itself computed causally (break bar volume vs the TRAILING 20-bar average strictly before the break bar) -- no look-ahead.

exit_shape.label: SS-B (current shipped ribbon_ride live exit shape, chart-stop-primary v15.3, read from automation/state/params.json at freeze time)
exit_shape.replay_mechanism: backtest/tools/t4_exit_matrix.py's replay()/ExitState/plan_exit_actions -- the SAME live exit_manager decision core the actuator runs (per instruction: 'exit_manager live scope for exits'). Local 5-min OPRA option bars via lib.option_pricing_real.load_contract_bars, zero network. qty fixed at 10 (T4/T5 convention) so expectancy is measured per-trade at a comparable size across cells; this is a research-scale qty, not a live sizing recommendation.
exit_shape.no_lookahead_note: Entry premium = the first available OPTION bar's OPEN at/after the entry timestamp (never a bar before decision time); exit replay walks strictly forward bar-by-bar from that fill.

nulls.random_entry_null: For every REAL episode (any variant/family/direction cell), generate one matched null episode: SAME date, SAME side, but entered at a bar time drawn uniformly at random from that day's RTH session (09:35-15:30 ET, deterministic seed=1407 for reproducibility -- 'does the trigger add anything beyond being long/short SPY options on a day the tape happened to move'). Same ATM strike/exit-shape/replay path.
nulls.opposite_direction_null: For every REAL episode, a second null: SAME entry timestamp/spot/strike-basis, OPPOSITE side (PUT<->CALL) -- 'is the DIRECTION call informative, or does entering either side at that instant look similar' (catches generic theta-bleed noise that would fool a same-side-only comparison).

windows.is_oos_split: IS = date < 2026-01-01, OOS = date >= 2026-01-01 (OOS_BOUNDARY, imported verbatim from backtest/autoresearch/strategy_space_grind.py -- same convention as every other T4/T5/P5 study in this repo, not re-derived).
windows.today_2026_07_14_excluded: By dataset construction (date_range ends 2026-07-13) -- confirmed, not assumed.

statistics.test: one-sample two-sided t-test of per-trade pnl vs 0, per candidate cell (12 cells: 3 variants x 2 families x 2 directions)
statistics.multiple_comparison_correction: Benjamini-Hochberg FDR across the 12 candidate-cell p-values, alpha=0.10. Null-comparison cells (random-entry, opposite-direction) are NOT part of the FDR family -- they are baselines a PASSING candidate must beat, not additional hypotheses under test.
statistics.evidence_floor: n >= 20 per cell (OP-16 doctrine floor) for a verdict to be FAIL rather than INCONCLUSIVE-underpowered.
statistics.concentration_disclosure: top-5-trade % of total cell pnl, reported for every cell regardless of verdict (OP-20).

pass_bar.statement: ALL of the following for a cell to PASS (anything else = FAIL, downgraded to INCONCLUSIVE only if n<20):
pass_bar.condition_3_walk_forward: WF = OOS_mean/IS_mean >= 0.70 (only defined/checked when IS_mean > 0; IS_mean <= 0 is an automatic FAIL, not an undefined pass)
pass_bar.condition_5_beats_both_nulls: cell's OOS expectancy > random_entry_null's OOS expectancy AND > opposite_direction_null's OOS expectancy (same side pairing)
pass_bar.condition_6_anchor_no_regression: informational only for this study (trendline-break entry is not currently armed on any live account, so there is no existing live rule to regress) -- reported as: does this cell fire on any of the 7 OP-16 anchor days (4/29,5/01,5/04 winners; 5/05,5/06,5/07x2 losers), and if so what does it do there. A PASS never requires anchor-day participation; catastrophic anchor-day losses are flagged even on an otherwise-PASSing cell.
pass_bar.aggregation: 1+2+3+4+5 are AND (any failing = FAIL, or INCONCLUSIVE if n<20).

ship_gate_if_pass: A PASS cell does NOT auto-arm live money (OP-0 #1). It qualifies for a new params.json shadow-to-live flip behind the standard OP-16 eval-first + A/B scorecard gate, paper-only, ships and reports for REVOKE per OP-0 -- no menu of options presented to J.
no_repick_clause: Once frozen, no variant definition, threshold (1.5 volume ratio, 10-bar retest window, ATM strike, SS-B shape params), null design, or FDR alpha may be edited in light of results. FAIL/INCONCLUSIVE is a publishable, informative outcome for as many of the 12 cells as it applies to -- not a reason to adjust and re-run.

closed_2026_09_02.verdict: 0 PASS, 12 FAIL. Every cell has NEGATIVE expectancy both in-sample and out of sample -- V2_break_retest_entry ranges $-98.69 to $-248.34, V3_break_volume_expansion $-44.37 to $-112.33, with OOS equally negative. Trendline BREAK entries are not an edge in any of the 12 cells tested.
closed_2026_09_02.reads_with: prereg-trendline-fade-battery-2026-07-14.json, run the same day. BREAK is uniformly negative; FADE has one survivor. If anything survives this family it is fading the break, not taking it.
